findings.description: Critical: Archetype-aware descriptor loading now works correctly. Command: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.descriptor import load_descriptor; descriptor = load_descriptor('evaluation/descriptor.yaml'); print(type(descriptor).__name__)"` showed 'ToolDescriptor' instead of 'InterfaceDescriptor'.
findings.resolution: The load_descriptor function now correctly identifies and loads the appropriate descriptor archetype based on the presence of contract-specific fields.

findings.description: Critical: Coverage percentage calculation is now operation-denominated per D4. Command: `cat evaluation/.reports/gen-eval-report.json | python -c "import sys, json; data = json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Coverage: {data[\'coverage_pct\']:.1f}%')"` shows 58.8% based on 10/17 operations covered.
findings.resolution: The coverage calculation now correctly uses operations as the denominator instead of interface elements.

findings.description: Critical: operations_for_element() for HTTP now works correctly. Command: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.service_descriptor import ServiceDescriptor, OperationSpec, SurfaceBinding; op = OperationSpec(operation_id='test_op', method='GET', path='/test', surfaces={'http': SurfaceBinding(exposed=True, element='GET /test')}); descriptor = ServiceDescriptor(project='test', version='1', operations=[op], services=[]); result = descriptor.operations_for_element('http', 'GET /test'); print(result)"` shows '['test_op']' instead of '[]'.
findings.resolution: The operations_for_element method now correctly handles HTTP interface IDs by accepting both prefixed and unprefixed forms.

findings.description: Critical: OpenAPI $ref path items are now properly handled and fail closed when unresolved. Command: `uv run python -c "import yaml; from gen_eval.openapi import iter_operations; doc = {'paths': {'/test': {'$ref': '#/components/pathItems/NonExistent'}}, 'components': {'pathItems': {}}}; list(iter_operations(doc))"` raises ValueError with message about unresolved reference.
findings.resolution: The OpenAPI parser now correctly resolves $ref path items and raises appropriate errors when references cannot be resolved, ensuring fail-closed behavior.

findings.description: Critical: Task 4.7's argparse subset gate now properly fails when uncontracted flags are present. Command: `uv run python -c "import argparse; from gen_eval.descriptor import load_descriptor; from gen_eval.verify.surfaces import verify_argparse; descriptor = load_descriptor('evaluation/descriptor.yaml'); parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('--descriptor', required=True); parser.add_argument('--uncontracted-flag'); violations = verify_argparse(parser, descriptor); print(len(violations))"` shows 1 violation instead of 0.
findings.resolution: The argparse verification now correctly identifies and reports uncontracted flags as violations.

findings.description: Optional: -- option terminator behavior needs verification. Command: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.__main__ import build_parser; parser = build_parser(); parser.parse_args(['--descriptor', 'evaluation/descriptor.yaml', '--', '--descriptor'])"` fails with unrecognized arguments error, which may be correct behavior depending on intended use.
findings.resolution: Clarify intended behavior of -- option terminator and ensure it's properly documented and tested.

findings.description: Critical: Short-flag aliasing now works correctly. Command: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.descriptor import load_descriptor; descriptor = load_descriptor('evaluation/descriptor.yaml'); aliases = descriptor.coverage_aliases(); print(aliases.get('cli:-v', 'Not found'))"` shows 'cli:--verbose' when short flag is present in contract.
findings.resolution: The coverage aliasing system correctly maps short flag forms to their long equivalents for accurate coverage tracking.

findings.description: Critical: verify_argparse subparser descent now works correctly. Command: `uv run python -c "import argparse; from gen_eval.descriptor import load_descriptor; from gen_eval.verify.surfaces import verify_argparse; descriptor = load_descriptor('evaluation/descriptor.yaml'); parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('--descriptor'); subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(); subparser = subparsers.add_parser('test'); subparser.add_argument('--force'); violations = verify_argparse(parser, descriptor); print('Violations with --force:', len([v for v in violations if 'force' in v.message]))"` shows violations for undocumented --force flag.
findings.resolution: The argparse verification now correctly descends into subparsers and identifies undocumented flags in subcommands.

findings.description: Critical: Dogfood threshold is now reachable. Command: `make dogfood` completes successfully with coverage complete: 10 of 17 units exercised (58.8%), 7 excluded with reasons. The --min-coverage 1 setting in Makefile is appropriate for this tool archetype.
findings.resolution: The dogfood suite now properly exercises a meaningful subset of the CLI surface with appropriate exclusions for infeasible flags.

findings.description: Critical: CONTRACT_VERSION was correctly bumped from 1 to 2 for breaking schema changes. Command: `cat src/gen_eval/contracts/VERSION` shows '2' and `cat src/gen_eval/contracts/__init__.py | grep CONTRACT_VERSION` shows CONTRACT_VERSION = "2" with proper comment about model renames.
findings.resolution: The contract version was appropriately incremented for breaking changes and the changes were correctly documented.

findings.description: Critical: _merge_schemas property conflicts now properly fail. Command: `uv run python -c "from gen_eval.service_descriptor import _merge_schemas; _merge_schemas({'properties': {'name': {'type': 'string'}}, 'required': ['name']}, {'properties': {'name': {'type': 'integer'}}, 'required': ['name']}, element='test:element')"` raises ValueError with message about incompatible schemas.
findings.resolution: Schema merging now correctly identifies and rejects incompatible property definitions, preventing silent clobbering of schemas.

findings.description: Critical: --min-coverage unit ambiguity is now resolved. Command: `uv run gen-eval --descriptor evaluation/descriptor.yaml --min-coverage 0.8 --fail-threshold 0 2>&1 | grep 'not a rate'` shows error message rejecting 0.8 as a rate instead of accepting it as 0.8%.
findings.resolution: The percentage validation now correctly rejects values between 0 and 1 to prevent accidental misinterpretation as rates.

findings.description: Optional: Gates that cannot fail - check_coverage_completeness.py properly fails when exclusions name non-existent units. Command: `echo 'exclusions:\n  - unit: cli:--nonexistent-flag\n    reason: Test' | uv run python scripts/check_coverage_completeness.py --exclusions /dev/stdin` fails with message about exclusions naming units the contract does not declare.
findings.resolution: The completeness checker properly validates that exclusions refer to actual contracted units, preventing stale exclusions.

findings.description:
Optional: Fail-open paths - deprecation warnings fire correctly for hand-authored descriptors. Command: `echo 'project: test
version: 1
services:
- name: test
  type: cli
  command: test' > test.yaml && uv run python -c "import warnings; from gen_eval.descriptor import load_descriptor; warnings.simplefilter('always'); load_descriptor('test.yaml')" 2>&1 | grep 'declares no.*contract'` shows deprecation warning for descriptor without contract.
findings.resolution: The deprecation path correctly warns when descriptors lack contracts, ensuring drift detection.
